title: Readings on New York time
prompt: The operations desk in New York reads every station's data on its own clock. Write `solve(observations)` so it returns `observation_id`, `observed_at`, the New York clock time `ny_time` and the New York date `ny_date`.
rules: `observed_at` is UTC. `ny_time` is the same moment as a clock in the `America/New_York` zone shows it, daylight saving included.
`ny_date` is the date of `ny_time`, as a date. Near midnight it can differ from the UTC date.
A missing `observed_at` gives missing results. Return the four columns, in that order, for every reading.
hints: `F.from_utc_timestamp(col, "America/New_York")` moves a UTC time onto the New York clock.
A fixed offset like `-05:00` is wrong for half the year.
Take `F.to_date` of the converted time, not of `observed_at`.
starter:
